editorial:
Imagine you are stuck in a fancy summer house on the coast of Italy with a family that is basically a disaster. You have Massimo, a guy who married into money and spends his time trying to sneak around with his mistress, Laura. The whole thing turns into a wild mess when he decides to disguise Laura as a nun just to keep her close without his rich wife finding out. He tells everyone she is there to tutor his daughter, Sonia, who is failing her classes. It is a wacky, sunny comedy that feels like a giant soap opera where everyone is lying to each other for some funny reason.

What makes this one work is the chaotic energy and the side plot with two clumsy criminals trying to pull off a kidnapping. The pacing is pretty quick, and while the plot is totally ridiculous, that is actually why it is fun. If you like old-school European comedies with plenty of misunderstandings, you will love this. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for a crisp look, or you might want to grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to keep those bright Italian colors forever.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart in a big, loud climax when the fake nun act is finally exposed. The two bumbling criminals fail miserably at their kidnapping plan, leading to a series of funny chases. In the end, the lies catch up to Massimo, and the family tensions boil over. However, instead of a tragedy, it wraps up with the usual comedic chaos where the characters learn their lessons, though they probably wont change their ways for long.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves wacky Italian comedies and farce.
